memory_candidates.content: When a shared library is extracted and made a HARD dependency of a script (source-or-exit-2), every test harness that copies collaborator scripts into a synthetic sandbox must also copy the new library. Omitting it does not fail loudly at the seam: the dependent script exits non-zero, its caller treats that as a normal negative result, and the suite falls through into an unrelated error branch and records spurious defects. Observed concretely: return-meta-status-vocabulary.sh was extracted into orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh but never added to test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh's setup_sandbox copy list, silently turning 34 of 110 fixtures red while every failure message pointed at a misleading downstream branch. Check: after any lib extraction, grep every tests/ sandbox copy list for the new filename in the same change.
